race.description: The Prince Of Merewether Provincial Hcp (Bm64)
race.comment: PRINCE OF SORTS (1) talented gelding who gets to his right trip third up from a low draw. Kept finding from the wide gate with a tough third over 1350m at Wyong. Claim helps again and can get the better of these today. THE STARS ALIGN (3) thrown in the deep end last start when up in class and trip for a poor last over 1600m at Randwick to The Mona Lisa in Midway class. Back in his right grade and can return to form quickly. FABRICE (2) jumped in grade and had excuses from the gate with a tiring tenth over 1600m at Randwick in Midway company. Earlier runs had merit and deserves another chance. THE TACT (7) tongue-tie goes on for this after he went under narrowly with the 62kg when second over 1412m at Taree on the heavy (8) surface. Proven at the trip and will relish the firmer surface.
